Name: Candace
Dialog: You know what people take for granted? The sounds of the summer: the way ice crackles in a cold beverage, the bees buzzing on their busy way, the chirping of the summer birds...

Name: Candace
Dialog: Okay, maybe they're acting up today. Ugh, I should've known better. I'll have to call you back, Stacy. A little Buford's telling me the boys are up to something.

Name: Baljeet
Dialog: I do not think that is what they sound like.

Name: Candace
Dialog: All right, what's with the weird noises?

Name: Phineas
Dialog: Hey, Candace! We're hoping to see the mockmacaws as they pass through Danville.

Name: Candace
Dialog: Mockma who now?

Name: Isabella
Dialog: (showing Candace a book) Yeah! Mockmacaws! Rare migratory birds that can camouflage themselves with their color-changing plumage.

Name: Buford
Dialog: They can also copy sounds and voices and stuff.

Name: Baljeet
Dialog: (showing a diagram) Genetically speaking, they fall somewhere between parrots and chameleons.

Name: Candace
Dialog: Whatever. Bird calls is a new low for you guys, right below the bookshelf. (leaves) Call me when you have something actually bustable.

Name: Phineas
Dialog: Maybe we should have told her about macaw mansion.

Name: Buford
Dialog: Funny, I noticed none of the ladies in your family like to look up.

Name: Isabella
Dialog: Ooh! Maybe we should build a Perry Palace next! Hey, where is Perry?

Name: Major Monogram
Dialog: Agent P, Doofenshmirtz has bought up all of the bug spray in the Tri-State Area. It could be that he's just hosting a little summer soiree. That would mean a bunch of evil scientists in one place. Conclusion: he must be up to something nefarious. You know what to do, Agent P.

Name: Major Monogram
Dialog: (looking at a notepad) Hey, Carl, how many people have RSVP'd to my barbecue?

Name: Carl
Dialog: (holding cooking utensils and wearing a "Kiss the Carl" apron) One.

Name: Major Monogram
Dialog: Is that including you?

Name: Carl
Dialog: Yes.

Name: Major Monogram
Dialog: So... none.

Name: Carl
Dialog: Don't judge yourself for this. This is not a measure of you as a man.

Name: Doofenshmirtz
Dialog: Psst! Down here!

Name: Doofenshmirtz
Dialog: Perry the Platypus, I'm so glad you're here. L-L-Lemme catch you up via monologue. I've recently gotten into home gardening, y'know, fruits and veggies, and the... Anyway, the garden was doing well, and it even attracted a colony of praying mantises. All female. Go figure. Vanessa got me this books of facts about them. (takes out the book) See? They naturally prey on garden pests. Mantis fact! (snaps fingers)

Name: Doofenshmirtz
Dialog: Now's our chance.

Name: Doofenshmirtz
Dialog: Anyway, I had a lot of pests, so I decided to make the mantises bigger using my ultra-grow-inator. I would behold it, but I left it on the balcony. (Doof pushes a lever making him and Perry fall into a vent, as they sneak in.) The inator has a reverse switch, but there's an entire army of giant mantises in the way. (Doof pulls another lever and they emerge on one of the couches in the living room.) So you've got to help me get out there, Perry the Platypus! It's the only way to defeat them.

Name: Isabella
Dialog: Phineas?

Name: Phineas
Dialog: Up here! (slides down a creeping vine)

Name: Buford
Dialog: Is all this worth it just to spot some dumb birds?

Name: Phineas
Dialog: Yes! Yes, it is!

Name: Ferb
Dialog: (showing a book) The only known photo is this blurry one where they camouflaged themselves as a Sasquatch.

Name: Isabella
Dialog: Then we'll get the first photo of one uncamouflaged! (She gives the gang Polaroid cameras.) Everyone got their cameras ready?

Name: Phineas
Dialog: Ferb, turn on the vacancy sign! We're open for business!

Name: Isabella
Dialog: Well, the mockmacaws are here, but they keep camouflaging every time I try to take their picture.

Name: Buford
Dialog: I thought there was more furniture here than I remembered.

Name: Candace
Dialog: Seriously? Birdwatching is so lame. (scoffs) I had such a good feeling about busting today, too.

Name: Candace
Dialog: A giant birdhouse?! How could I have missed it?! MOOOOOOOOOOOM!!!!

Name: Linda
Dialog: (offscreen) Yes, Candace, what is it?

Name: Candace
Dialog: Follow me outside, and be prepared to look up!

Name: Doofenshmirtz
Dialog: We should study up, Perry the Platypus. It's like they say, "Know thy enemy." I don't know who says that. (looks through book) Bu-but look, mantises have long necks, triangular heads, and bulging eyes. Ooh, kinda like me! (snaps fingers) Mantis fact! Did you know that mantises are the only insects who can see in 3D? (snaps fingers) Mantis fact! Look, my inator! (picks it off the floor) Ugh, the battery's dead. Ooh, Perry the Platypus, you've got to try my homegrown rhubarb. Here, I'll break you off a piece.

Name: Doofenshmirtz
Dialog: Did you know that they're the only insect that can turn their head 180º? (snaps fingers) Mantis fact!

Name: Doofenshmirtz
Dialog: Oh, just like that, see?

Name: Perry
Dialog: (slaps himself and chatters)

Name: Doofenshmirtz
Dialog: Oh, I can't stop snapping so loudly when I say, "Mantis fact." (snaps fingers)

Name: Doofenshmirtz
Dialog: (screams) Huh?

Name: Doofenshmirtz
Dialog: Oh, uh... oh! (takes the ring) Well, this is so sudden, but... but yes! A thousand times yes! And now that I've married into the family, I can use this mantis army to take over the entire Tri-State Area! Ladies, trap Perry the Platypus!

Name: Doofenshmirtz
Dialog: Ha ha! See that? That's called "karma"! You do a little good and the universe pays you back with a whole lotta evil! Right, honey?

Name: Linda
Dialog: A bird mansion? Well, that's certainly something new.

Name: Candace
Dialog: Just stop painting that vintage carousel horse and come see!

Name: Doofenshmirtz
Dialog: How thoughtful! They're even going to feed me before we take over the Tri-State Area!

Name: Doofenshmirtz
Dialog: Okay, but you're supposed to bring the food out on the platter. It's... It's okay, we'll work on that part.

Name: Doofenshmirtz
Dialog: Hey, what was that for?

Name: Doofenshmirtz
Dialog: Um, wait. Mantises eat their husbands?! (snaps fingers sadly) Mantis fact!

Name: Doofenshmirtz
Dialog: One of my recurring nightmares is being cooked and served as dinner, so this is... weirdly familiar to me.

Name: Isabella
Dialog: They're so good at camouflage, they must've slipped right past us.

Name: Phineas
Dialog: (pointing up the tree) Wait, look! Up in the tree!

Name: Isabella
Dialog: (gasps)

Name: Isabella
Dialog: I can't get a clear shot.

Name: Baljeet
Dialog: Buford!

Name: Buford
Dialog: What? (comes down) I thought I'd shake things up.

Name: Baljeet
Dialog: Oh, yes. (imitating Buford) "Shake things up."

Name: Buford
Dialog: Well, that's weird.

Name: Mockmacaws
Dialog: (imitating Buford) "Shake things up."

Name: Candace
Dialog: Mom, look, it's the bird mansion! It's right there!

Name: Candace
Dialog: Mom, you're looking right at it! Wait, you can see it?

Name: "Linda"
Dialog: Yes, Candace.

Name: Candace
Dialog: You mean, for once, you actually are seeing what the boys built? My busting dream has finally come true? Today be-eth the day?

Name: "Linda"
Dialog: Yes, Candace. Bawk!

Name: Candace
Dialog: Oh, no! It's one of those stupid birds! (runs back into the house) It's two of those stupid birds!

Name: Doofenshmirtz
Dialog: Mantis facts are a lot less fun when your life is on the line, huh?

Name: Doofenshmirtz
Dialog: If only I had a battery, but there's so many mantises between me and the bottom drawer in my kitchen.

Name: Doofenshmirtz
Dialog: Excellent! Thank you, Perry the Platypus!

Name: Astronaut
Dialog: Houston, it's happening again!

Name: Doofenshmirtz
Dialog: I don't have very good aim.

Name: Doofenshmirtz
Dialog: Phew!

Name: Doofenshmirtz
Dialog: Take my advice, Perry the Platypus, stay single as long as you can.

Name: Isabella
Dialog: If only we could get them down here somehow.

Name: Baljeet
Dialog: "I'm Buford. Let's try solving our problems with brute strength."

Name: Buford
Dialog: "Oh, I'm Baljeet, and I am bein' real judgy today."

Name: Mockmacaw
Dialog: (imitating Baljeet) Real judgy. (caws)

Name: Phineas
Dialog: They're mockmacaws! They love it when we mock each other. Oh, oh, we could use that!

Name: Isabella
Dialog: "I'm Buford and I like to eat bugs!"

Name: Buford
Dialog: Mmmm, you know it.

Name: Phineas
Dialog: Check out my Ferb! (stands still)

Name: Isabella
Dialog: That sounds just like Ferb!

Name: Buford
Dialog: "And I'm Phineas, and my head doesn't make any biological sense!"

Name: Phineas
Dialog: Ha ha! It's like listening to a mirror!

Name: Phineas
Dialog: Ooh, hold still, Isabella. I think I can get you in the shot, too!

Name: Doofenshmirtz
Dialog: Not so threatening now that you're back to your normal size, are you?

Name: Doofenshmirtz
Dialog: Heh, heh, uh, good thing I appreciate irony?

Name: Candace
Dialog: No feathers this time, right? (grabs her) Come on!

Name: Linda
Dialog: What does that even mean?

Name: Doofenshmirtz
Dialog: C'mon, c'mon! "Big" me again! "Big" me!

Name: Candace
Dialog: (pointing up) Mom! Look!

Name: Doofenshmirtz
Dialog: (groans) Oh, I forgot to hit the reverse switch, so it just made me even smaller. (to the mantises) Wait, hold on. Shouldn't we at least try couples counseling first?

Name: Linda
Dialog: Well, I wouldn't call it giant. Great job, boys! This deserves pie!

Name: Candace
Dialog: But but but but...

Name: Baljeet
Dialog: I think our feathered friends have finally departed.

Name: Buford
Dialog: So, didja get the photo?

Name: Phineas
Dialog: Oh, no! It must've camouflaged itself as me right before the flash went off! Sorry, Isabella, I really thought I had it.

Name: Isabella
Dialog: It's okay, Phineas. (hugs him) I still appreciate all the help. (quietly) And something tells me I'm gonna treasure this photo even more.

Name: Candace
Dialog: (to her mom) You've gotta believe me! There were these color-changing, voice-copying birds hiding the boys' invention the whole time!

Name: Linda
Dialog: I believe. RAWK!

Name: Candace
Dialog: Wait a second...

Name: Candace
Dialog: Not you too, Perry! You can't all be birds! (starts growing feathers) What's happening?!? What is even real?! (looks at her hand) No! (looks at herself) Nooooooo! Caaaaawwwww, caw caw caw!!! (squawks repeatedly)

Name: Doofenshmirtz
Dialog: (sighs) I am so tired. The jet lag is really hitting me now, I just... (sighs) (beat) I should probably get up. This floor is just so comfortable. Is... Is this pine? (beat) Two more minutes, that's all.
